decontamination: Remove campaign and fixed hashed character-5-gram cosine >= .85 matches against all earlier acquired historical, financial, IMC and eligible SMS-history messages. Remove conflicting labels and normalized duplicate texts. Compute .85 near-copy connected components within the new corpus before stratified splitting; remove conflicting components. No fitted model consulted.
previous_test_policy: Prior financial test retired and unused; prior SMS-history test explicitly retired and partitioned 80/20 into development. Historical train/validation preserved. Old reported tests never described as independent evidence again.
base_weight: Equal class mass, source mass within class and campaign-group mass within source/class; multiply ham by declared factor then normalize all weights to mean 1.
selection: For each of six refitted candidates, maximize macro spam recall over validation sources subject to empirical FPR <= 1% separately for every ham source. Ties: lower mean FPR, then higher threshold. Select candidate by higher macro recall then lower mean FPR; remaining ties by declared C then ham multiplier order. No refit on validation.
controls: Evaluate frozen original baseline, frozen previous adapted model, and the previous adapted model with its threshold recalibrated on this validation set by the identical rule. Threshold-only control is not eligible for candidate selection.
test_rule: Score untouched test once, only selected candidate and three declared controls; publish all outcomes. No further tuning after inspection.
promotion_rule: Candidate test FPR <= 1% and <= original baseline FPR; paired group-bootstrap upper 95% bound on FPR change versus previous adapted model < 0; lower 95% bound on recall change >= -0.03 versus both original and previous adapted models. Passing only permits considering deployment, not a production safety claim.

uncertainty.method: paired class-stratified whole connected-component bootstrap; conditional on models and observed source

source_audit: No model scores used to choose source, rows or split.
